description: An introduction to the Internet, the World Wide Web (WWW) and mobile communications technologies. Topics include: HTML; web-page design tools; development of simple mobile applications. Additional topics selected from: location-aware e-commerce; multimedia chat services; mobile social networking; software development for smartphone and tablets. Emphasis is on relating Internet technologies to the role they play enabling mobile computing.
supplementalNotes:
• Credit will be granted for only one of CSC 130, HINF 115, SENG 130.
  • Not open to third- or fourth-year students in a Computer Science or Software Engineering program.
title: World Wide Web and Mobile Applications
